title: Frozen UI Shell and Home Fidelity

notes: Implements screenshot-level fidelity for the shared authenticated shell and final frozen Home reference only; it does not reopen design decisions.
Reuses existing Home recommendation, creation, performance and Brand/channel contracts without changing their domain semantics.
Removes or hides legacy technical/internal navigation and Home chrome from the normal creator experience while preserving underlying governed lineage.
Analytics shown on Home remain truthful: unavailable observations are not fabricated or coerced to zero for visual parity, and generic engagement counts are not labeled as engagement rate.
Approved but unavailable Home behavior is preserved visibly and truthfully in the UI and recorded in docs/plans/KAIRO-UI-FUNCTIONALITY-GAPS-2026-08-25.md.
No API, worker, migration, provider, tenant-boundary, publishing-authority or analytics-collection behavior is changed in this slice.
Rendered desktop/mobile evidence passed in temporary non-production workflow 32863800449; artifact 9569274055 contains desktop/mobile captures, approved Home reference crop, DOM evidence and logs.
UI Review found no Blocker/Major visual or responsive discrepancy; mobile rendered at 390px with no horizontal document overflow.
The temporary visual workflow and fixture scripts were removed after evidence capture; Vercel Git deployment remains disabled and production was untouched.
VS-90 remains released/inactive in post-release observation with issue #192 open; activating VS-91 does not mark VS-90 validated.
Implementation and testing are complete. VS-91 is now at the certification gate; certification, merge, release, production-enable and deployment remain separate exact-SHA human gates.

approvals.rationale: After all approved UI work was declared frozen, the Product Owner approved the strict implementation plan and said Go. VS-91 is the first bounded execution batch: shared shell plus exact frozen Home fidelity, with later surfaces split into subsequent reviewable slices.
No new product, security, publishing, provider or analytics policy is introduced. Existing approved decisions and frozen design authority are reused unchanged.

The Product Owner explicitly said Go after the strict frozen-UI implementation sequence and verification rules were stated. Runtime work is limited to the allowed frontend/design-token paths and this bounded Home/shell scope.
All implementation/testing evidence is complete; certification still requires explicit approval of the final immutable candidate SHA.
No release authorization is granted by the implementation Go.
No production enablement or deployment is authorized by the implementation Go.
